entries.title: Monument Valley / readable structure
entries.observed: Light walking planes and darker walls separate the central crossing. Coral concentrates on the destination and lower control.
entries.transfer: Tiny Trouble: distinguish the changing object, new safe surface and destination with value and open space.
entries.limit: Control appearance is visible; transformation timing and puzzle solvability were not tested.

entries.title: Monument Valley / silhouette and space
entries.observed: A white figure and warm pedestal sit inside a broad cool field; the background converges around the subject.
entries.transfer: Tiny Trouble: protect Pip’s silhouette without adopting the reference architecture or palette.
entries.limit: Composition still; not traversal or full-game readability evidence.

entries.title: It Takes Two / imaginative scale
entries.observed: Body-height controls, thick cables and large fabric weave establish miniature scale. Braced hands and bent legs show effort.
entries.transfer: Tiny Trouble: use a few readable construction cues and intentional poses at the actual play camera.
entries.limit: A held pose does not establish anticipation, easing or input responsiveness.

entries.title: It Takes Two / expressive pose
entries.observed: Open arms, separated brows, wide eyes and an open mouth make an emphatic silhouette; paper and cloth construction remain visible.
entries.transfer: Tiny Trouble: keep Pip’s simpler rig; test look, brace and settle responses around existing actions.
entries.limit: No animation sequence was played. No claim of timing parity.

entries.title: Animal Crossing / contextual communication
entries.observed: Two large heads remain above one pale dialogue area, with a name tab and clear text hierarchy.
entries.transfer: Tiny Trouble: keep one immediate message and leave the acting character visible during feedback.
entries.limit: A still supports layout observation, not dialogue pacing or physical touch comfort.

entries.title: Animal Crossing / coherent objects
entries.observed: Wood, cloth and metal have distinct cues inside softened proportions; small object clusters surround clear character space.
entries.transfer: Tiny Trouble: harmonize edge softness and broad material groups before adding fine detail.
entries.limit: Publisher still. Ambient motion and sound were not reviewed.

entries.title: Overcooked / bounded work area
entries.observed: Brighter work planes separate the central kitchen from its darker perimeter. Isolated ingredient icons and white hats aid recognition.
entries.transfer: Tiny Trouble: preserve a readable active work area, Pip and useful prop through transient feedback.
entries.limit: Publisher comparison still; not evidence of comedic timing or uninterrupted motion.

catalog_note.title: Stardew Valley / musical organization
catalog_note.observation: The composer catalog separates seasonal, location and character pieces. Metadata establishes organization only.
catalog_note.transfer: Develop an original Pip motif and contrasting breakfast, workshop and harbor arrangements. Preserve the warm wood/fabric/chime family.
catalog_note.limit: No reference audio was auditioned. Melody, instrumentation, emotional effect and loop comfort remain unassessed.
